title: DocumentationCoverageAndSourceReview
description: Compatibility filename; not a clinical readiness score. v2.1 adds per-flag `severity` + `kind` and the top-level source-recency block. `severity` is the extraction / archive-integrity uncertainty grade of a flag — it is NOT a clinical severity and never ranks how sick the patient is. Legacy schema_version "2" archives are read leniently by validate_structured_outputs.py (WARN, not FAIL).

latest_source_date.description: Latest report/exam date among the dated source documents of this archive (sidecar filename date prefix under NN_ buckets; patient supplements 14_ and prior-archive digests excluded). Computed by scripts/source_freshness.py; null only when no source carries a date.

days_since_latest.description: as_of_run_date - latest_source_date in days. More than 14 days requires a warnings[] line that states the day count ("… N 天 …").

as_of_run_date.description: The run date the recency is measured against (YYYY-MM-DD): the LOCAL calendar date of the run, passed to scripts/source_freshness.py --as-of. update_log entries[].at are UTC ISO timestamps, so the validator accepts an as_of_run_date within ±1 day of an entries[].at (or organize_meta.generated_at) date.

channel.description: Optional read channel of this value (the sidecar `## 不确定字段` readings[].channel vocabulary), so several readings of the same source line — incl. a channel that read nothing (value null) — stay distinguishable.

severity.description: Extraction / archive-integrity uncertainty grade (NOT clinical severity).

kind.description: legibility = characters not resolvable (only for uncertainty entries with layout none); artifact = stain/shadow/fold/strike-like layout anomaly read literally (any entry whose layout is not none, incl. shadow_stain_fold); document_intent = deletion/amendment/handwritten correction, ONLY when two independent reads agree (otherwise downgrade to artifact); conflict = sources disagree; completeness = missing pages / stale sources; other = e.g. untrusted-content or faithfulness flags.

refs.description: Bucket-relative sidecar anchors of the OTHER documents carrying the same (or a contradicting) reading.

uncertain_ids.description: Ids of the sidecar `## 不确定字段` entries ([OCR_UNCERTAIN:U-nnn] tokens) this flag covers.

items.$comment: The mechanical rows of organizer-prompt-phase2-synthesis.md §6.1 (severity decides whether the field may be used as a confirmed value). The rows that need the sidecar entry (field_class, layout) or the pairing record are checked by validate_structured_outputs.py.
